# Magic Valley Remodels and Repairs LLC

> A trusted choice for bathrooms, kitchens and all phases of residential and commercial remodeling in Twin Falls and the Magic Valley, Idaho. A one-stop shop for complete remodels, including framing, plumbing and electrical. Bathrooms are a specialty. No roofing. Owner Tito Herrera, remodeling since 2003. Rated 5.0 on Google (11 reviews).

- Phone: 208-613-6837
- Email: magicvalleyremodels@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM
- Service area: Twin Falls and the surrounding Magic Valley, Idaho
